fixed: Connecting a device to a large library no longer reports most of it as "records from another device couldn't be used and were skipped". When the sync server asks the device to slow down part-way through, Device Sync keeps what it has fetched, shows "Waiting to sync", and carries on by itself every minute until everything is here.
A sync that loses its connection or times out while fetching from your other devices keeps what it had already fetched, instead of starting again from the beginning next time.
The Device Sync part of the diagnostics export now says which HTTP status each skipped-record notice came from, such as "[HTTP 404 ×3]".

added: `SyncReport.httpStatus` carries the HTTP status of the response that raised a report, when one did.
`syncApplyKindOrder` exposes the apply engine's kind order, in which every other kind a record can cite comes before it (cross-kind only: a dance can still cite another dance).
